description: Client-side script for managing UI interactions in OrchardCore setup, including toggling connection string sections, password visibility, recipe description updates, and localization URL setting.

methods.name: toggleConnectionStringAndPrefix
methods.description: Shows or hides connection string and table prefix sections based on selected database provider.

methods.name: refreshDescription
methods.description: Updates recipe button text and description based on selected recipe.

methods.name: setLocalizationUrl
methods.description: Sets up event listener to change page URL based on selected culture.

methods.name: togglePasswordVisibility
methods.description: Toggles input type between password and text, and updates icon accordingly.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and UI setup for the setup page.
